This camera performs amazingly well with excellent iq. What i really like this camera body is its ability to work with many vintage 35 mm lenses from the film era.
The manual focusing with those vintage lenses is a breeze with the focus peaking and image magnification function of the camera body. I get into the habit of doing manual focusing with all my lenses (including my auto focusing ones), just to make sure all the shots are sharp because it is so easy to do focusing manually.

This is an update of my camera review. I have been using this camera for 7months now. I still like it just as when i first got it in January when i wrote the above review. But i found there maybe some serious flaw for this camera.I have a friend who also had the sony a7 ii but his camera the shutter will not work whenever he turned it on. The camera asked him to turn off the switch and starting again, but that will not work. I searched the net and found there are many exactly the same problems for sony a7 series camera. It is apparently the manufacturer's responsibility to fix it for free but sony will not do it after the warranty runs out. It has not happen to my camera but there is always a shadow in my mind and wonder if it will happen to my camera one of these days. I will down grade this camera to one star for this serious potential flaw on some of the cameras. I still love this camera as it works wonder when it works.

Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me. We’ve purchased this twice. The first one stopped connecting to the internet after a year. We tried the factory reset 8 times. My husband purchased again hoping it was just a fluke and the second one would work. We’ve had our second one since June and as I’m typing this, he’s on his 3rd factory reset because the internet went down in our area and it will not connect to our devices. Maybe this is great if you don’t have a home with lots of smart lights and other products. This might also be great if you never lose internet connectivity or power. All that being said, we started having issues pretty much the day the warranty expired and tech support is zero help. If you have the money to throw away and like headaches, give it a whirl. Otherwise, just rent one from your internet provider.
